# Material Flat

Material Flat is a mobile-friendly theme that derives nearly every color from the Obsidian accent and adapts to light and dark modes. It adds a customizable floating action button, window translucency through the window manager, and themed support for plugins; the recorded description states that Style Settings is required.

![Material Flat screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/threethan/obsidian-material-flat-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Material Flat"
    author: "threethan"
    repo:   "threethan/obsidian-material-flat-theme"
    slug:   "material-flat"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/material-flat"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/threethan/obsidian-material-flat-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/threethan/obsidian-material-flat-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a mobile-friendly, accent-driven look that adapts to light and dark modes and derives nearly every color from your Obsidian accent. Add a customizable floating action button, window translucency via the window manager, and themed support for plugins (Style Settings required)."
}
```
